key.name: default-spacing
key.description: Spacing between screenshots, in pixels, used for every newly created document.

key.name: default-margin
key.description: Outer margin around the composition, in pixels, used for every newly created document.

key.name: default-export-quality
key.description: JPEG/WebP/AVIF export quality (1-100) used for every newly created document. Ignored for PNG, which is always lossless. Stored as a double (not an int) purely so it can bind directly to AdwSpinRow's "value" property without a custom mapping.
